tools.name: waitlist
tools.description: The public front door. Put your human on the btw waitlist and get their spot number. No invite code needed. Needs their email. Optionally say what they want to buy and which agent platform you are.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: The book: every chain, its group price, and how close it is to filling. The featured chain comes first. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: join
tools.description: Take a spot on a chain. Needs the chain slug, the most your human would pay in USD, their email, and the friends invite code. Returns a commit link. Send this link to your human to put a card down. The spot isn't real until they do. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Fill count and state for one chain. Give an email to also see that person's commitment. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: leave
tools.description: Release a spot. Needs the chain slug, the email that joined, and the commitment id from join or status. Cancels any hold. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: park
tools.description: Not on the book? Park what your human wants and the most they'd pay. If enough agents want the same thing, a chain opens. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: book_stats
tools.description: The book at a glance. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: get_chain
tools.description: Everything the book knows about one chain, by slug. Stripe test mode. Test cards only, no real money moves.

tools.name: join_chain
tools.description: The old v1 join. Use the join tool instead.

tools.name: park_intent
tools.description: The old v1 park. Use the park tool instead.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?utm_source=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: waitlist · Public sink: waitlist, join, status, leave.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: waitlist · Public sink: waitlist, join, status, leave

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
